The result of the free DKIM Checker for the public domain mailchimp.com, run without a selector: the heading Your DKIM records, the summary 9 DKIM records discovered, 6 healthy, 3 needs attention (completed in 0.3s) with the note A published key does not prove your mail is being signed., and the first rows k2 (RSA 2048, healthy), google (RSA 1024, needs attention), k3 (healthy), k1 (RSA 1024, needs attention), mte1, mte2, zendesk2 and zendesk1 (all RSA 2048, healthy).
